description_en: Queries the alert switch information for unusual logon IP addresses, unusual logon times, and unusual logon accounts
description_zh: 查询非常用登录IP、非常用登录时间、非常用登录账号的报警开关信息
name: DescribeLoginSwitchConfigs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder (Alibaba Cloud account). You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Item.description_en:
The type of the switch to be enabled or disabled. Valid values:
login_common_ip: Alerts for unusual logon IP addresses.
login_common_time: Alerts for unusual logon times.
login_common_account: Alerts for unusual logon accounts
Item.description_zh:
指定要开启或关闭的开关类型。
取值：
login_common_ip：  非常用登录IP告警
login_common_time： 非常用登录时间告警
login_common_account： 非常用账号登录告警

Status.description_en:
The enabling status of Simple Log Service. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
Status.description_zh:
日志服务的启用状态。
取值：
0：关闭
1：开启

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned in the configuration list
Count.description_zh: 配置列表的返回个数信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
